name: Enter The Eternity
source:
A dating simulator in which Michi (name customizable) signs up to study at the Matsubara Institute for a semester and lives in a shared house. The problem is: every single one of your roommates is a magical girl (or boy, or person)!

How will you survive abroad with magical girls? Will you be able to adapt to this new life and make friends? Better yet, will you end up dating one of them? 

[From [url=https://rainspicestudios.itch.io/entertheeternity]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款约会模拟器，Michi（姓名可自定义）报名参加松原学院一个学期的学习，并住在合租的房子里。问题是：你的每一位室友都是魔法女孩（或男孩，或人）！

和魔法少女一起在异国他乡如何生存？你能适应新的生活并结交朋友吗？更好的是，你最终会和其中一位约会吗？

[来自[url=https://rainspicestudios.itch.io/entertheeternity]itch.io[/url]]
